Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure
Sponsor: Sells
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/15/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 279 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Public Service Commission to develop a website to collect consumer complaints regarding cellular phone service and forward that information to the respective cellular phone service companies.
Lynn Greer, Chair
Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure
